cut.note: adopted cut=6580 (=E10 n, conservative: OOS starts ~1.5d before doc date, zero leakage possible)

rules: R1 selection/param search MUST use only bars [0:6580).
R2 bars [6580:N) are frozen OOS: no selection, no refit, no threshold tuning on OOS.
R3 locked-point OOS diagnostic allowed only as read-only report, never as selection input.
R4 any new bar appended at N extends frozen OOS; cut_index never moves without new lock doc.
R5 this task is read-only: no orders, no broker calls.
